algorithm_name: DTV — Discrimination-Tempered Voting (variants DTV-dev, DTV-free; supersedes the working name "RTC", retired to avoid collision with ReASC arXiv:2601.02970 "Reliability-Aware Adaptive Self-Consistency")
summary: DTV replaces the fixed confidence exponent of CISC with an exponent estimated from the SIGNED WITHIN-ITEM DISCRIMINATION of the confidence channel, shrunk to a one-sided lower confidence bound so that "no evidence of discrimination" produces gamma_hat = 0 exactly, i.e. bit-identical plain self-consistency. Vote weights are w_i = exp(gamma * s_i) where s_i is a within-item, standardized, monotone-invariant score of c_i (van der Waerden normal score of the midrank by default). Three things make this more than "CISC with a tuned knob". (1) The exponent is not grid-searched: gamma* is DERIVED as the Nitzan-Paroush log-odds slope under an equal-variance latent-normal model of the score, giving the closed-form link gamma* = u*sqrt(1 + pbar(1-pbar)u^2) with u = sqrt(2)*Phi^{-1}((1+D)/2) and D = 2*AUC-1 = 2*WQD-1 the pair-weighted within-item Somers' D. (2) The DTV family is proven to be exactly CISC's own one-parameter family reparameterized (T = sigmabar/gamma), EXTENDED to gamma<0, which CISC's positive-temperature softmax cannot express; this is what lets DTV exploit rather than merely survive an anti-correlated channel. (3) The core contribution, per the emphasis, is the LABEL-FREE estimator of D. It uses the agreement pseudo-label e_i = 1[a_i = SC plurality], whose bias is derived exactly rather than assumed away: on majority-correct items the pseudo-label EQUALS correctness; on majority-wrong items it flips and attenuates. This yields a GLS de-attenuated estimator D_free = sum_q n_q kappa_q D_q^agree / sum_q n_q kappa_q^2 with kappa_q = (2*pi_q - 1)_+ the item's pseudo-label quality, plus an INDEPENDENT Hui-Walter / two-population latent-class estimator that identifies both the channel's discrimination and pi from the (agreement x high-confidence) 2x2 tables stratified by vote margin — a design that also supplies a computable lack-of-fit test for the conditional-independence assumption echo regimes violate. The two estimators are combined by intersecting their one-sided LCBs, so a sign disagreement returns exactly 0 (= SC). We prove the sign of D is information-theoretically unidentifiable without labels (a single-channel restatement of Parisi et al.'s global sign ambiguity), give the exact echo-poisoning threshold xi_bar < |D|(2*pibar-1)/(1-pibar), and show that ~25 labeled items suffice to purchase the sign bit at 80% power for |D|>=0.3 — so the honest product is "label-free strength, 25-item sign certificate", not an unconditional guarantee.
emphasis: LABEL-FREE FIRST. DTV-dev exists mainly as an oracle-ish reference and as the vehicle for the 25-item sign certificate; it is openly positioned as shrunk logistic recalibration + Nitzan-Paroush log-odds pooling, i.e. a repackaging of known pieces that will likely only TIE CISC's own dev-tuned-temperature protocol on iid splits (pre-registered expectation; F4 must include CISC-devT or reviewers will add it). All novelty claims rest on: (a) the label-free signed-discrimination estimator with its exact bias decomposition, GLS de-attenuation, Hui-Walter cross-check and lack-of-fit-based echo detector; (b) the identifiability theorem and the quantified echo-poisoning threshold, presented as a documented limitation with a cheap escape hatch rather than a solved case; (c) the adversarial confidence-usage frontier (kappa_c < 0), which no prior SC/CISC/DeepConf/ReASC paper evaluates; (d) the finite-sample SC-safety proposition P(DTV != SC | D=0) <= alpha, which converts G2 from an unfalsifiable slogan into a provable statement under the null plus a pre-registered non-inferiority test off the null.
math:
========================================================================
0. NOTATION
========================================================================
Items q = 1..Q. Item q has m_q cached traces. Trace i of item q has answer
a_{q,i} (already mapped to a canonical answer-cluster id by the TracePool's
dedup/semantic equivalence) and confidence c_{q,i} in [0,1].
z_{q,i} = 1[a_{q,i} is correct]  (available on dev only).
n1_q = #{i: z=1}, n0_q = #{i: z=0}, n_q = n1_q * n0_q  (# within-item
discordant pairs; n_q = 0 on all-correct or all-wrong items).
pbar = (sum_q n1_q) / (sum_q m_q)  = pooled trace-level accuracy.

------------------------------------------------------------------------
1. SCORE MAP  S: within-item transform of confidence
------------------------------------------------------------------------
r_{q,i} = midrank of c_{q,i} within item q (ties averaged).

(S1) rank_normal  (DEFAULT, monotone-invariant, Blom/van der Waerden):
     s~_{q,i} = Phi^{-1}( (r_{q,i} - 0.375) / (m_q + 0.25) )
     s_{q,i}  = (s~_{q,i} - mean_q s~) / sd_q(s~)      [ddof=0]
     if sd_q(s~) < 1e-12  (all confidences tied)  =>  s_{q,i} := 0 for all i.

(S2) rank_uniform (Wilcoxon score):  s_{q,i} = sqrt(12)*((r_{q,i}-0.5)/m_q - 0.5)
     (equals S1 to within a factor sqrt(1 - 1/m^2) in the untied Gaussian case)

(S3) value_z  (used ONLY for the exact CISC-softmax anchor):
     s_{q,i} = (c_{q,i} - mean_q c) / sigmabar,  sigmabar a GLOBAL constant
     (pooled within-item sd of c over the dev pool). Not per-item.

(S4) log  (used ONLY for the exact CISC-power anchor):
     s_{q,i} = log(clip(c_{q,i}, eps, 1)),  NOT standardized.

S1 and S2 are invariant under any strictly increasing reparameterization of
c (per-item or global), hence immune to arbitrary monotone miscalibration —
regime (ii) is handled by construction. S1/S2 are NOT invariant to tie
structure; see failure modes.

------------------------------------------------------------------------
2. WEIGHT TRANSFORM AND DECISION RULE
------------------------------------------------------------------------
Multiplicative form (DEFAULT, DTV-M):
     w_{q,i}(gamma) = exp( gamma * s_{q,i} )                          (1)
     V_q(y; gamma)  = sum_i w_{q,i}(gamma) * 1[a_{q,i} = y]
     yhat_q         = argmax_y V_q(y; gamma)
Ties in the argmax broken by a fixed canonical answer-cluster id, IDENTICAL
across all methods in the harness (so gamma=0 reproduces SC bitwise).

Additive form (DTV-A, secondary; Bayes-optimal under the model of Sec. 3):
     w_{q,i}(gamma) = max(0, 1 + gamma * s_{q,i})                     (1')
Since exp(x) = 1 + x + O(x^2), V^M and V^A agree to first order in gamma and
both equal the SC count at gamma = 0. (1) is primary because it gives the
EXACT CISC reduction and is nonnegative by construction; (1') is the exact
naive-Bayes log-odds pool and is run as an ablation.

------------------------------------------------------------------------
3. WHY exp(gamma*s) AND WHAT gamma OUGHT TO BE  (derivation, not a heuristic)
------------------------------------------------------------------------
Model M0 (per item, conditional on the item):
  (a) z_{q,i} ~ Bern(p_q) independently across traces;
  (b) s_{q,i} | z_{q,i}=1 ~ N(mu1, sigma^2);  s | z=0 ~ N(mu0, sigma^2);
      Delta := mu1 - mu0;  by the standardization of Sec.1,
      E[s]=0 and Var(s)=1, hence
              sigma^2 + pbar(1-pbar)*Delta^2 = 1.                     (2)
  (c) an incorrect trace draws its wrong answer from q(.) independent of s.

Posterior correctness of a single trace:
     logit P(z=1 | s) = alpha + (Delta/sigma^2) * s.                  (3)
Naive-Bayes MAP over answers (log-posterior of answer y):
     log P(y | data) = const + sum_{i: a_i = y} [ logit P(z_i=1|s_i) - log q(y) ]
                     = const + sum_{i: a_i = y} [ b + (Delta/sigma^2) s_i ]  (4)
with b = alpha - log q. (4) is exactly the ADDITIVE rule (1') with
gamma = Delta/sigma^2 and offset b (normalized to b=1). The multiplicative
rule (1) is its exponential-family surrogate, exact to O(gamma^2), and the
one that reproduces CISC. Therefore:

     gamma*  =  Delta / sigma^2.                                       (5)

Link to a label-free-estimable, monotone-invariant quantity. Define
     AUC := P( s(correct trace) > s(incorrect trace) )  within item
     D   := 2*AUC - 1   (Somers' D / rank-biserial; D = 2*WQD - 1 in CISC's
            notation — this statistic is CISC's, we do not claim it).
Under M0(b), AUC = Phi(Delta/(sigma*sqrt(2))), so with
     u := Delta/sigma = sqrt(2) * Phi^{-1}( (1+D)/2 ),                 (6)
and using (2), sigma^2 = 1/(1 + pbar(1-pbar) u^2), hence

  ****  gamma*(D, pbar) = u / sigma = u * sqrt( 1 + pbar(1-pbar) u^2 )  ****  (7)
        with u = sqrt(2) * Phi^{-1}( (1+D)/2 ).

Checks: gamma*(0,.) = 0 exactly; gamma* is odd in D (Phi^{-1}((1-x)/2) =
-Phi^{-1}((1+x)/2)); strictly increasing in D; -> +-inf as D -> +-1; the
pbar correction is <= 12% for |D| <= 0.52 and may be dropped (set pbar=0 or 1)
at the cost of absorbing it into eta.

------------------------------------------------------------------------
4. RELIABILITY STATISTIC: exact estimator and sampling distribution
------------------------------------------------------------------------
Per item (labels available):
     U_q  = sum_{i: z=1} r_{q,i}  -  n1_q(n1_q+1)/2        (Mann-Whitney U)
     A_q  = U_q / n_q ,   D_q = 2 A_q - 1                  (undefined if n_q=0)
Pair-weighted pooled estimator (the estimand is the PAIR-WEIGHTED mean of D_q,
not the plain mean — this matters under heterogeneous per-item kappa):

     Dhat = ( sum_q n_q D_q ) / ( sum_q n_q )
          = ( 2 sum_q U_q - sum_q n_q ) / ( sum_q n_q ).               (8)

Null sampling distribution (H0: within each item, s is exchangeable w.r.t.
correctness, i.e. D = 0). Exact per-stratum Wilcoxon null variance with tie
correction:
     T_q      = sum_{tie groups g} (d_g^3 - d_g) / ( m_q (m_q - 1) )
     Var0(D_q)= ( (m_q + 1) - T_q ) / ( 3 n_q )
     Var0(Dhat) = [ sum_q n_q ( (m_q+1) - T_q ) / 3 ] / ( sum_q n_q )^2. (9)
Asymptotically normal as Q -> inf (stratified Wilcoxon CLT, m_q bounded).
Numbers to pre-register: Q=400, m=40, pbar=0.6 => n_q=384, SE0 = 0.0094
(threshold z*SE0 = 0.0155, i.e. AUC 0.508); Q=50 => SE0 = 0.027 (AUC 0.522).
So the shrinkage floor binds only in a genuinely near-null channel.

General (non-null) SE: Dhat is a Hajek ratio of item-level sums, so use the
delete-one-ITEM jackknife (clustering at the item, never at the trace):
     SEjack^2 = ((Q-1)/Q) * sum_q ( Dhat_{(-q)} - mean_q Dhat_{(-q)} )^2. (10)
Report SE = max(SEjack, SE0) so the floor is never optimistic.
Bias: Dhat is exactly unbiased for the pair-weighted average of the per-item
D_q under M0(b); it is NOT unbiased for the unweighted average when kappa
varies with item difficulty (documented limitation).

Budget invariance: D is a pairwise functional, so E[Dhat] does not depend on
m_q; a gamma_hat estimated at m=40 transfers to a deployment budget m=8.
Var scales as 1/(sum_q n_q).

------------------------------------------------------------------------
5. TEMPERING MAP g  (shrinkage + link + clip)
------------------------------------------------------------------------
     LCB soft-threshold (one-sided, level alpha_s):
        Dtil = sign(Dhat) * max( 0, |Dhat| - z_{1-alpha_s} * SE )      (11)
        Dtil <- clip(Dtil, -Dmax, +Dmax),  Dmax = 0.999
     Link + fractional trust + cap:
        gamma_hat = clip( eta * gamma*(Dtil, pbar_hat), -Gamma, +Gamma ) (12)
with gamma* from (7). Composite:
        g(Dhat, SE) = clip_{[-Gamma,Gamma]} ( eta * h(soft(Dhat,SE)) ),
        h(x) = sqrt(2)Phi^{-1}((1+x)/2) * sqrt(1 + pbar(1-pbar)*2*Phi^{-1}((1+x)/2)^2).

Alternative shrinkers (ablation only): positive-part James-Stein
Dtil = Dhat * max(0, 1 - SE^2/Dhat^2); EB posterior mean under a normal prior
on the Fisher-z scale atanh(D) with hyper-variance estimated across regimes.
The LCB (11) is the DEFAULT because it, and only it, yields Proposition P4.

SC-SAFETY PROPOSITION (P4). If D = 0 (channel exchangeable w.r.t. correctness),
then by validity of the one-sided (1-alpha_s) LCB, P(Dtil != 0) <= alpha_s,
hence P(DTV output != SC output on ANY item of the pool) <= alpha_s, hence
     E[acc(DTV)] >= E[acc(SC)] - alpha_s.                              (13)
With alpha_s = 0.05 the accuracy deficit under a useless channel is bounded by
0.05 in the worst case and empirically by far less (a nonzero gamma_hat that
survives shrinkage is small, so most predictions still agree with SC). No
distribution-free guarantee is available off the null; G2 there is an
empirical, pre-registered non-inferiority claim (F2).

------------------------------------------------------------------------
6. DTV-dev  (labeled dev split, estimate once)
------------------------------------------------------------------------
Compute (8),(9),(10) on the dev pools using the SAME answer clustering and the
SAME score map as deployment; compute pbar_hat; apply (11),(12); freeze
gamma_hat; deploy (1). Requirements: effective pair count sum_q n_q >= 200 and
at least 30 items with n_q > 0, else return gamma_hat = 0 and log a warning.
Optional nonparametric extension DTV-np (answer to regime iv, "informative only
in the tails"): fit lambda_hat(s) = logit P(z=1|s) by isotonic regression or a
monotone spline on the pooled (s, z) dev data, shrink toward the linear fit
alpha + gamma_hat*s by a factor rho_np chosen by dev cross-validation, and use
w_{q,i} = exp( lambda_shrunk(s_{q,i}) - mean_q lambda_shrunk ). Flat lambda =>
SC exactly; linear lambda => DTV-M exactly.

------------------------------------------------------------------------
7. DTV-free  (LABEL-FREE / ONLINE)  -- the core
------------------------------------------------------------------------
7.1 Pseudo-label and its EXACT bias decomposition
Let yplur_q = plain-SC plurality of item q (NEVER DTV's own output — see
failure modes: self-confirmation). Pseudo-label
     e_{q,i} = 1[ a_{q,i} = yplur_q ],
     k_q = #{e=1}, n_q^ag = k_q (m_q - k_q),
     D_q^ag = 2*AUC(s ; e) - 1  computed by (8)'s rank identity with e in
              place of z.
Let M_q = 1[ yplur_q is correct ], pi_q = P(M_q = 1 | observables).

  Case M_q = 1: e_{q,i} = 1[a_i = y*] = z_{q,i} EXACTLY (a trace agrees with the
  plurality iff it is correct). Hence  E[D_q^ag | M_q=1] = D.          (14)

  Case M_q = 0: the plurality is a wrong cluster y'. Then {e=1} is a SUBSET of
  the incorrect traces and {e=0} contains ALL correct traces plus the non-echo
  wrong traces. Write
     E[D_q^ag | M_q=0] = - rho_q * D + xi_q,                            (15)
  rho_q in [0,1] the attenuation from mixing correct with non-echo-wrong traces
  in the e=0 group (rho_q = 1 exactly when every incorrect trace is in the echo
  cluster), and xi_q the ECHO-CONFIDENCE term: the rank-biserial advantage the
  echo cluster enjoys over the other wrong traces. xi_q > 0 is precisely
  "high confidence on the wrong echo" (harness regime iii).

Combining, with kappa_q := 2*pi_q - 1:
     E[D_q^ag] = kappa_q * D  +  (1-pi_q) * [ (1-rho_q) D + xi_q ].      (16)
The working model is rho_q = 1, xi_q = 0, under which E[D_q^ag] = kappa_q * D
EXACTLY — the class-conditional-noise attenuation, with flip rate 1-pi_q.

7.2 The information/trust tension (state it, do not hide it)
n_q^ag = k_q(m_q - k_q) is MAXIMIZED at a 50/50 split, i.e. exactly on the
items where pi_q is LOWEST. Naive pair-weighted pooling therefore concentrates
all weight on the least trustworthy items. Unanimous items carry pi_q ~ 1 but
n_q^ag = 0 and contribute nothing. This is intrinsic, not an artifact.

7.3 GLS de-attenuated estimator (fixes 7.2 optimally under the working model)
Var(D_q^ag) ~ v_q = ((m_q+1) - T_q) / (3 n_q^ag). GLS for the mean-kappa_q*D
model gives
     Dhat_free = [ sum_q (kappa_q^+ / v_q) D_q^ag ] / [ sum_q ((kappa_q^+)^2 / v_q) ]
               = [ sum_q n_q^ag kappa_q^+ D_q^ag ] / [ sum_q n_q^ag (kappa_q^+)^2 ]  (17)
     (second line drops the near-constant ((m+1)-T)/3 factor at fixed m)
     kappa_q^+ = max(0, 2*pihat_q - 1)   (items judged more-likely-wrong-plurality
                                          are DROPPED, never negatively weighted).
(17) simultaneously (a) down-weights low-margin items quadratically in the
denominator, (b) de-attenuates by dividing by kappa, (c) is the GLAD-style
"weight by item discriminability" move, (d) is a ratio of item sums so the
item-level jackknife (10) is valid for its SE.

Plim and exact bias (from (16)):
     plim Dhat_free = D + [ sum_q nu_q (1-pi_q)((1-rho_q) D + xi_q) ]
                          / [ sum_q nu_q kappa_q ],   nu_q = n_q^ag kappa_q^+   (18)
Bias bound:  |bias| <= (1 - pi_min) [ (1-rho_min)|D| + xi_max ] / kappabar.
SIGN-PRESERVATION CONDITION (the quantified echo threshold; take rho=1):
     xibar  <  |D| * (2*pibar - 1) / (1 - pibar).                       (19)
pibar=0.9 => tolerates xibar < 8|D|; pibar=0.7 => xibar < 1.33|D|;
pibar=0.6 => xibar < 0.5|D|; pibar -> 0.5 => zero tolerance. Regime (iii) of
the harness sweeps xi directly against this predicted boundary.

7.4 Estimating pi_q without labels
(a) Effective sample size from the TracePool similarity matrix Sim_q (Kish):
     n_eff,q = m_q^2 / sum_{i,j} Sim_q[i,j];   k_q^eff = k_q * n_eff,q/m_q.
(b) Margin -> pi map. Fit a two-component beta-binomial mixture to the item-level
    top-share statistic (k_q^eff, n_eff,q) across items: component 1
    (plurality correct) with Beta(A1,B1), component 0 with Beta(A0,B0), mixing
    weight PI, constrained A1/(A1+B1) > A0/(A0+B0) (the identifying restriction,
    see 7.6). pihat_q = posterior P(comp 1 | k_q^eff, n_eff,q).
(c) MANDATORY guard: if BIC prefers the 1-component model, do NOT trust the
    mixture; fall back to a conservative monotone map
    pihat_q = clip( 2*Bbar(k_q^eff/n_eff,q) - 1, 0, 1 ) calibrated only up to
    the assumption that pi is nondecreasing in the top share, and set
    kappa_q^+ = 0 for all items with top-share < 0.5 (drop split items).
(d) DTV-dev-lite option: if a sign-certificate dev set exists (7.7), fit the
    margin->pi map ON IT (K items) — this costs no extra labels beyond the
    certificate and removes the mixture's identifiability risk.

7.5 Independent estimator: Hui-Walter / two-population latent class (DTV-free-HW)
Views per trace: e (agreement, as above) and h = 1[s_{q,i} > 0] (within-item
median split; exactly balanced when m even and untied).
Bin items into B bins by vote margin (default B = 4, margin quartiles).
Assume: latent z; conditional independence e ⟂ h | z; conditional probabilities
     alpha1 = P(e=1|z=1), alpha0 = P(e=1|z=0),
     beta1  = P(h=1|z=1), beta0  = P(h=1|z=0)
SHARED across bins; prevalence p_b free per bin.
Counting: 3B free observed cells vs 4 + B unknowns => identified iff B >= 2.
This is exactly the Hui-Walter no-gold-standard design, equivalently a
2-annotator Dawid-Skene made identifiable by multiple prevalence strata.
Fit by EM (E: posterior of z per (bin, e, h) cell; M: closed-form updates).
Recover:
     d_h  = Phi^{-1}(beta1) - Phi^{-1}(beta0)        (= Delta/sigma = u)
     D_HW = 2*Phi(d_h / sqrt(2)) - 1                                    (20)
     pbar_HW = sum_b n_b p_b / sum_b n_b ,  and pi is read off from alpha1,alpha0
     WITHOUT any margin model — an independent route to the same quantities.
LACK-OF-FIT TEST (the Jaffe-style dependence diagnostic, made concrete):
     X2 = sum over (bin, e, h) cells of (O - E)^2 / E,  df = 3B - (4+B) = 2B - 4
     (df = 4 at B = 4). A small p-value certifies violation of conditional
     independence given correctness — which is exactly what echo/duplication
     produces. Pre-registered rule: p < 0.01 => discard D_HW.

7.6 Consensus rule (continuous, conservative, sign-disagreement -> SC)
For each estimator E in {GLS, HW} form one-sided LCBs
     L_E^+ = max(0,  Dhat_E - z SE_E),   L_E^- = max(0, -Dhat_E - z SE_E)
     Dtil_free = min(L_GLS^+, L_HW^+)  -  min(L_GLS^-, L_HW^-).          (21)
At most one of L^+, L^- is positive per estimator, so opposite signs give
Dtil_free = 0 EXACTLY, and (21) is continuous everywhere (min of continuous
positive parts). Feed Dtil_free into (12). If the HW lack-of-fit fires, use GLS
alone but multiply z by 2 (double the shrinkage) and log the degradation.

7.7 Identifiability theorem and the 25-item sign certificate
THEOREM (single-channel sign non-identifiability). The observables are
{(cluster-id, confidence)}; "correct" is an unobserved labeling of one cluster
per item. For any generative model with parameters (pi, D, F0, F1) there is a
relabeling of the designated-correct cluster on every item inducing parameters
(pi', D') with pi' = P(runner-up correct) and D' the rank-biserial w.r.t. that
relabeling, under which the joint law of the observables is IDENTICAL. Hence no
label-free estimator can identify sign(D) without an external restriction. Ours
is pibar > 1/2 (equivalently alpha1 > alpha0 in HW; equivalently the mixture
ordering constraint in 7.4b). This is Parisi et al. (PNAS 2014) global sign
ambiguity in single-channel clothing, and echo regimes are exactly the case
where the restriction is FALSE.
ESCAPE HATCH (cheap, and we recommend it as the shipped default): a SIGN
CERTIFICATE of K labeled items. Test H0: D <= 0 vs H1: D > 0 by the stratified
Wilcoxon (8) restricted to those K items. Power calc from (9): SE0 =
sqrt(((m+1)-T)/(3*K*n_q)) = 0.188/sqrt(K) at m=40, n_q=384; detecting |D|=0.3
at 80% power one-sided 5% needs (1.645+0.84)*0.188/sqrt(K) <= 0.3 => K >= 3.
We pre-register K = 25 (8x margin for item-level clustering, heterogeneity, and
smaller m). If the certificate's sign disagrees with Dtil_free's sign, set
gamma_hat = 0 and raise an echo alarm. THE SIGN BIT IS ~25 LABELS; THE STRENGTH
IS FREE. That is the honest product.
Optional module (only principled escape without labels): Prelec
surprisingly-popular voting, requiring an extra per-trace meta-prediction
("what fraction of samples will answer X?"). Specified as an optional harness
regime, not part of the core algorithm.

7.8 Online / streaming schedule (prequential, no self-confirmation)
- Warm-up: first W0 = 50 items use gamma = 0 (pure SC).
- Sliding window of the most recent W = 500 items; refresh every U = 25 items.
- The gamma applied to item q is estimated ONLY from items strictly before q.
- The agreement pseudo-label is ALWAYS computed against the plain-SC plurality
  of the estimation-window items, never against DTV's weighted output.
- Estimation may use the full cached pool (m=40) even when deployment uses
  m=8, since D is budget-invariant (Sec. 4); pihat, however, MUST be computed
  at the deployment m (margins shrink with m).

------------------------------------------------------------------------
8. ECHO / DEPENDENCE SAFETY LAYER
------------------------------------------------------------------------
Per item, flag echo if BOTH
  (i) n_eff,q / m_q < rho_dup  (default 0.5; duplication-driven plurality), AND
  (ii) mean_{i in plurality} s_{q,i} > tau_s (default 0.5 sd; the plurality is
       also the high-confidence cluster).
Flagged items: kappa_q^+ := 0 (excluded from estimation; their VOTES are
unaffected).
Global rule: let f = flagged fraction. If f > tau_echo (default 0.25) OR the HW
lack-of-fit p < 0.01 while GLS and HW disagree in sign, then gamma_hat := 0
(hard SC fallback) and emit ECHO_ABSTAIN. This is what makes G2 attainable in
practice, and it is CONDITIONAL by construction — say so in the paper.

------------------------------------------------------------------------
9. COMPLEXITY
------------------------------------------------------------------------
Scoring + ranks: O(sum_q m_q log m_q). D_q by the rank-sum identity: O(m_q) after
ranking. Pooled estimator and jackknife: the jackknife is O(Q) using the
running-sum identity Dhat_{(-q)} = (Snum - n_q D_q)/(Sden - n_q), NOT O(Q^2).
Beta-binomial mixture EM: O(Q * iters). Hui-Walter EM: O(4B * iters), B=4 =>
negligible. Voting: O(sum_q m_q). Total one pass, fully numpy-vectorizable;
end-to-end cost on 7 regimes x 400 items x 40 traces is < 1 s in numpy, so the
whole falsifier grid with 200 bootstrap replicates is minutes, not hours.
Memory O(sum_q m_q).
pseudocode:
```python
# dtv.py  —  Discrimination-Tempered Voting.  numpy/scipy only.
import numpy as np
from scipy.stats import rankdata, norm, chi2

Z_SHRINK   = 1.645   # one-sided 95% LCB
GAMMA_MAX  = 3.0
ETA        = 1.0
DMAX       = 0.999
EPS        = 1e-12

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- scores
def item_scores(c, kind="rank_normal", sigmabar=None):
    """c: (m,) confidences of ONE item -> s: (m,) score. mean 0, var 1 for rank maps."""
    m = len(c)
    if kind == "log":                       # exact CISC-power map (NOT standardized)
        return np.log(np.clip(c, 1e-6, 1.0))
    if kind == "value_z":                   # exact CISC-softmax map
        return (c - c.mean()) / sigmabar    # sigmabar is a GLOBAL constant
    r = rankdata(c, method="average")       # midranks; ties averaged
    if kind == "rank_normal":
        s = norm.ppf((r - 0.375) / (m + 0.25))          # Blom / van der Waerden
    elif kind == "rank_uniform":
        s = np.sqrt(12.0) * ((r - 0.5) / m - 0.5)
    else:
        raise ValueError(kind)
    s = s - s.mean(); sd = s.std()
    return s / sd if sd > EPS else np.zeros(m)          # all-tied item -> SC

def score_pool(pool, kind="rank_normal", sigmabar=None):
    return [item_scores(it.conf, kind, sigmabar) for it in pool]

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- voting
def vote(pool, S, gamma, form="mult"):
    """Returns predicted answer-cluster id per item. gamma=0 -> bitwise SC."""
    out = np.empty(len(pool), dtype=np.int64)
    for qi, (it, s) in enumerate(zip(pool, S)):
        w = np.exp(gamma * s) if form == "mult" else np.maximum(0.0, 1.0 + gamma * s)
        tally = np.bincount(it.ans, weights=w, minlength=it.n_clusters)
        best  = np.max(tally)
        cand  = np.flatnonzero(tally >= best - 1e-12)
        out[qi] = cand.min()                 # canonical id tie-break, shared by ALL methods
    return out

# ------------------------------------------------- discrimination statistic
def item_D(s, lab):
    """Somers' D of s vs binary lab within one item. Returns (D, npair, m, tiecorr)."""
    n1 = int(lab.sum()); m = len(lab); n0 = m - n1
    if n1 == 0 or n0 == 0:
        return 0.0, 0, m, 0.0
    r = rankdata(s, method="average")
    U = r[lab == 1].sum() - n1 * (n1 + 1) / 2.0
    _, cnt = np.unique(s, return_counts=True)
    T = ((cnt**3 - cnt).sum()) / (m * (m - 1)) if m > 1 else 0.0
    return 2.0 * U / (n1 * n0) - 1.0, n1 * n0, m, T

def pooled_D(Ds, npairs, ms, Ts):
    """Eq.(8) point estimate, Eq.(9) null SE, Eq.(10) item-jackknife SE (O(Q))."""
    Ds, npairs = np.asarray(Ds, float), np.asarray(npairs, float)
    ms, Ts     = np.asarray(ms, float),  np.asarray(Ts, float)
    keep = npairs > 0
    Ds, npairs, ms, Ts = Ds[keep], npairs[keep], ms[keep], Ts[keep]
    if npairs.sum() < 1: return 0.0, 1.0, 0
    num, den = (npairs * Ds).sum(), npairs.sum()
    D = num / den
    se0 = np.sqrt((npairs * ((ms + 1.0) - Ts) / 3.0).sum()) / den            # Eq.(9)
    loo = (num - npairs * Ds) / np.maximum(den - npairs, EPS)                # Eq.(10)
    Q = len(Ds)
    sej = np.sqrt((Q - 1.0) / Q * ((loo - loo.mean())**2).sum()) if Q > 1 else se0
    return D, max(se0, sej), Q

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- tempering
def gamma_star(D, pbar):
    """Eq.(7): derived Nitzan-Paroush log-odds slope."""
    D = np.clip(D, -DMAX, DMAX)
    u = np.sqrt(2.0) * norm.ppf((1.0 + D) / 2.0)
    return u * np.sqrt(1.0 + pbar * (1.0 - pbar) * u * u)

def temper(Dhat, SE, pbar, z=Z_SHRINK, eta=ETA, gmax=GAMMA_MAX):
    """Eqs.(11)-(12). Continuous, odd, monotone; EXACTLY 0 when |Dhat| <= z*SE."""
    Dtil = np.sign(Dhat) * max(0.0, abs(Dhat) - z * SE)                      # Eq.(11)
    return float(np.clip(eta * gamma_star(Dtil, pbar), -gmax, gmax))         # Eq.(12)

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- DTV-dev
def fit_dtv_dev(dev_pool, kind="rank_normal", z=Z_SHRINK, eta=ETA):
    S = score_pool(dev_pool, kind)
    st = [item_D(s, it.correct) for it, s in zip(dev_pool, S)]
    D, SE, Q = pooled_D(*map(list, zip(*st)))
    pbar = np.mean(np.concatenate([it.correct for it in dev_pool]))
    tot_pairs = sum(x[1] for x in st)
    if tot_pairs < 200 or Q < 30:
        return 0.0, dict(reason="insufficient_dev_pairs", pairs=tot_pairs, Q=Q)
    g = temper(D, SE, pbar, z, eta)
    return g, dict(D=D, SE=SE, pbar=pbar, pairs=tot_pairs, Q=Q, gamma=g)

# --------------------------------------------------- DTV-free : agreement GLS
def agreement_stats(pool, S):
    out = []
    for it, s in zip(pool, S):
        cnt   = np.bincount(it.ans, minlength=it.n_clusters)
        plur  = int(np.argmax(cnt))
        e     = (it.ans == plur).astype(int)
        D, npair, m, T = item_D(s, e)
        srt   = np.sort(cnt)[::-1]
        top   = srt[0] / len(it.ans)
        marg  = (srt[0] - (srt[1] if len(srt) > 1 else 0)) / len(it.ans)
        neff  = effective_n(it)                     # Kish, from TracePool Sim
        out.append(dict(D=D, npair=npair, m=m, T=T, k=int(e.sum()),
                        top=top, margin=marg, neff=neff, plur=plur,
                        s_plur=float(s[e == 1].mean()) if e.sum() else 0.0))
    return out

def effective_n(it):
    Sim = it.sim                                    # (m,m) in [0,1], 1 on diagonal
    m = Sim.shape[0]
    return float(m * m / max(Sim.sum(), EPS))

def estimate_pi(st, use_mixture=True):
    """pihat_q = P(plurality correct | margin). Beta-binomial 2-mixture on (k_eff, n_eff),
       ordering constraint mean1 > mean0; BIC-guarded fallback to a conservative
       monotone rule."""
    keff = np.array([a["top"] * a["neff"] for a in st])
    neff = np.array([a["neff"] for a in st])
    if use_mixture:
        fit = betabinom_mixture_em(keff, neff, ordered=True)   # returns dict(post, bic1, bic2)
        if fit["bic2"] + 2.0 < fit["bic1"]:                    # 2 components genuinely better
            return np.clip(fit["post"], 0.0, 1.0), "mixture"
    top = np.array([a["top"] for a in st])                     # conservative fallback
    pi  = np.where(top < 0.5, 0.0, np.clip(2.0 * top - 1.0, 0.0, 1.0))
    return pi, "monotone_fallback"

def dtv_free_gls(st, pi, echo_mask):
    """Eq.(17) + item jackknife."""
    kap = np.maximum(0.0, 2.0 * np.asarray(pi) - 1.0)
    kap[echo_mask] = 0.0
    n   = np.array([a["npair"] for a in st], float)
    Dq  = np.array([a["D"] for a in st], float)
    num_i, den_i = n * kap * Dq, n * kap * kap
    if den_i.sum() <= EPS:
        return 0.0, 1.0
    D = num_i.sum() / den_i.sum()
    loo = (num_i.sum() - num_i) / np.maximum(den_i.sum() - den_i, EPS)
    Q = len(Dq)
    SE = np.sqrt((Q - 1.0) / Q * ((loo - loo.mean())**2).sum())
    return float(D), float(max(SE, 1e-4))

# --------------------------------------------------- DTV-free : Hui-Walter
def dtv_free_hw(pool, S, st, B=4):
    """2-view (agreement e, high-conf h) latent class over B margin bins.
       Identified for B>=2. Returns (D_HW, SE_HW, pbar_HW, lof_p)."""
    marg = np.array([a["margin"] for a in st])
    bins = np.clip(np.searchsorted(np.quantile(marg, np.linspace(0, 1, B + 1)[1:-1]), marg), 0, B - 1)
    tab = np.zeros((B, 2, 2))                       # counts of (e,h) per bin
    for qi, (it, s) in enumerate(zip(pool, S)):
        cnt = np.bincount(it.ans, minlength=it.n_clusters)
        e = (it.ans == int(np.argmax(cnt))).astype(int)
        h = (s > 0).astype(int)
        for ei in (0, 1):
            for hi in (0, 1):
                tab[bins[qi], ei, hi] += np.sum((e == ei) & (h == hi))
    a1, a0, b1, b0 = 0.75, 0.35, 0.65, 0.45         # init; ordering a1>a0 imposed
    p = np.full(B, 0.6)
    for _ in range(500):                            # EM
        post = np.zeros((B, 2, 2))
        for b in range(B):
            for ei in (0, 1):
                for hi in (0, 1):
                    l1 = p[b] * (a1 if ei else 1 - a1) * (b1 if hi else 1 - b1)
                    l0 = (1 - p[b]) * (a0 if ei else 1 - a0) * (b0 if hi else 1 - b0)
                    post[b, ei, hi] = l1 / max(l1 + l0, EPS)
        w1 = tab * post; w0 = tab * (1 - post)
        p  = w1.sum((1, 2)) / np.maximum(tab.sum((1, 2)), EPS)
        a1 = w1[:, 1, :].sum() / max(w1.sum(), EPS); a0 = w0[:, 1, :].sum() / max(w0.sum(), EPS)
        b1 = w1[:, :, 1].sum() / max(w1.sum(), EPS); b0 = w0[:, :, 1].sum() / max(w0.sum(), EPS)
        if a1 < a0:                                  # identifying restriction: agreement
            a1, a0, b1, b0, p = a0, a1, b0, b1, 1 - p   # is positively informative
    d_h  = norm.ppf(np.clip(b1, 1e-4, 1 - 1e-4)) - norm.ppf(np.clip(b0, 1e-4, 1 - 1e-4))
    D_HW = 2.0 * norm.cdf(d_h / np.sqrt(2.0)) - 1.0                       # Eq.(20)
    # lack-of-fit chi-square, df = 2B-4  (conditional-independence / echo diagnostic)
    X2 = 0.0
    for b in range(B):
        n_b = tab[b].sum()
        for ei in (0, 1):
            for hi in (0, 1):
                E = n_b * (p[b] * (a1 if ei else 1 - a1) * (b1 if hi else 1 - b1)
                           + (1 - p[b]) * (a0 if ei else 1 - a0) * (b0 if hi else 1 - b0))
                X2 += (tab[b, ei, hi] - E) ** 2 / max(E, 1.0)
    lof_p  = 1.0 - chi2.cdf(X2, max(2 * B - 4, 1))
    SE_HW  = hw_bootstrap_se(pool, S, st, B)         # item-level cluster bootstrap, 200 reps
    pbarHW = float((p * tab.sum((1, 2))).sum() / max(tab.sum(), EPS))
    return float(D_HW), float(SE_HW), pbarHW, float(lof_p)

# --------------------------------------------------- DTV-free : orchestration
def fit_dtv_free(pool, kind="rank_normal", z=Z_SHRINK, eta=ETA,
                 rho_dup=0.5, tau_s=0.5, tau_echo=0.25, sign_cert=None):
    S  = score_pool(pool, kind)
    st = agreement_stats(pool, S)
    echo = np.array([(a["neff"] / a["m"] < rho_dup) and (a["s_plur"] > tau_s) for a in st])
    pi, pi_mode = estimate_pi(st)
    D_g, SE_g   = dtv_free_gls(st, pi, echo)
    D_h, SE_h, pbar_h, lof_p = dtv_free_hw(pool, S, st, B=4)
    if lof_p < 0.01:                                    # dependence detected -> distrust HW
        L = [(D_g, 2.0 * z * SE_g)]                     # double the shrinkage
    else:
        L = [(D_g, z * SE_g), (D_h, z * SE_h)]
    Lp = min(max(0.0, d - s) for d, s in L)             # Eq.(21): intersect one-sided LCBs
    Lm = min(max(0.0, -d - s) for d, s in L)
    Dtil = Lp - Lm                                      # signs disagree => exactly 0
    info = dict(D_gls=D_g, SE_gls=SE_g, D_hw=D_h, SE_hw=SE_h, lof_p=lof_p,
                pi_mode=pi_mode, echo_frac=float(echo.mean()), Dtil=Dtil)
    if echo.mean() > tau_echo or (lof_p < 0.01 and np.sign(D_g) != np.sign(D_h)):
        return 0.0, dict(info, abstain="ECHO_ABSTAIN")                    # hard SC fallback
    if sign_cert is not None:                            # 25-item sign certificate (Sec 7.7)
        s_sign = certified_sign(sign_cert, kind)         # +1 / -1 / 0 (inconclusive)
        if s_sign != 0 and Dtil != 0 and np.sign(Dtil) != s_sign:
            return 0.0, dict(info, abstain="SIGN_CONFLICT")
    pbar = pbar_h if lof_p >= 0.01 else 0.5
    g = float(np.clip(eta * gamma_star(np.clip(Dtil, -DMAX, DMAX), pbar), -GAMMA_MAX, GAMMA_MAX))
    return g, dict(info, gamma=g, pbar=pbar)

# --------------------------------------------------- online / streaming
def dtv_online(stream, W0=50, W=500, U=25, **kw):
    """Prequential: gamma applied to item q uses ONLY items < q, and the agreement
       pseudo-label is ALWAYS the plain-SC plurality (never DTV's own output)."""
    hist, gamma, preds = [], 0.0, []
    for q, item in enumerate(stream):
        s = item_scores(item.conf, kw.get("kind", "rank_normal"))
        preds.append(vote([item], [s], gamma)[0])
        hist.append(item)
        if len(hist) >= W0 and (q + 1) % U == 0:
            gamma, _ = fit_dtv_free(hist[-W:], **kw)
    return np.array(preds)
```

map S in {rank_normal, rank_uniform, value_z, log} (including the degenerate

Hence  V_q(y; 0) = sum_i 1 * 1[a_{q,i} = y] = #{i : a_{q,i} = y},
which IS the plain self-consistency tally. Because the argmax tie-break is the
same canonical answer-cluster id used by the SC baseline in the harness, the
two methods emit bitwise-identical predictions on every item of every pool, so
their paired McNemar table is diagonal by construction.
For the additive form (1'): w_{q,i}(0) = max(0, 1 + 0) = 1, same conclusion.

CRUCIALLY, gamma_hat = 0 is ATTAINED ON A SET OF POSITIVE PROBABILITY, not
merely approached in a limit: by (11), Dtil = 0 whenever |Dhat| <= z*SE, and by
(12) gamma*(0, pbar) = sqrt(2)*Phi^{-1}(1/2)*sqrt(1+0) = 0. Under D = 0 this
event has probability >= 1 - alpha_s. This is strictly stronger than CISC's
SC anchor, which is only the improper limit T -> infinity, and it is what makes
Proposition P4 (E[acc(DTV)] >= E[acc(SC)] - alpha_s under the null) provable.
Consensus rule (21) also returns EXACTLY 0 whenever the two label-free
estimators disagree in sign, and the echo layer returns EXACTLY 0 on abstain.

========================================================================
P2. FULL TRUST => CISC, EXACTLY (two forms; both are pointwise identities)
========================================================================
(a) CISC-power form, w_i = c_i^gamma. Take S = log, i.e. s_{q,i} = log c_{q,i}
(unstandardized). Then for any gamma:
        w_{q,i} = exp(gamma * log c_{q,i}) = c_{q,i}^gamma,
        V_q(y) = sum_i c_{q,i}^gamma 1[a_{q,i} = y],
which is the CISC-power tally term by term. Therefore
        DTV(gamma = Gamma, S = log)  ==  CISC-power(gamma = Gamma)
as functions on every pool, for every Gamma. Setting the cap Gamma equal to the
CISC exponent makes the full-trust limit of DTV literally the CISC baseline.

(b) CISC-WQN / softmax form, w_i = exp(c_i/T) / sum_j exp(c_j/T). Take
S = value_z with a GLOBAL constant sigmabar: s_{q,i} = (c_{q,i} - cbar_q)/sigmabar.
Then
   w_{q,i} = exp( gamma (c_{q,i} - cbar_q)/sigmabar )
           = exp(-gamma cbar_q / sigmabar) * exp( c_{q,i} / (sigmabar/gamma) )
           = K_q * exp( c_{q,i} / T ),      T := sigmabar/gamma,  K_q > 0.
K_q depends on q only, so
   V_q(y; gamma) = K_q * sum_i exp(c_{q,i}/T) 1[a_{q,i}=y]
                 = K_q * (sum_j exp(c_{q,j}/T)) * V_q^{CISC-WQN}(y; T),
a strictly positive item-constant multiple of the CISC-WQN tally. Positive
rescaling preserves the argmax AND the entire ranking over answers, so the two
rules coincide pointwise on every item, for every gamma > 0. The map
gamma |-> T = sigmabar/gamma is a bijection (0, inf) -> (0, inf).

(c) THE TWO FAMILIES ARE THE SAME FAMILY. Combining P1 and P2(b):
        gamma = 0        <=>  T -> +inf   <=>  plain SC
        gamma -> +inf    <=>  T -> 0+     <=>  argmax-confidence selection
        gamma in (0,inf) <=>  T in (0,inf) bijectively.
So {DTV(gamma) : gamma >= 0} is EXACTLY CISC's one-parameter family
reparameterized, and DTV additionally realizes gamma < 0 (formally T < 0),
which a positive-temperature softmax cannot express. This is the precise,
non-inflated statement of the contribution: DTV does not propose a new
weighting family; it (i) extends CISC's family to negative exponents and
(ii) supplies a closed-form, shrunk, label-free ESTIMATOR of where to sit on
it. Any claim beyond this would be false and reviewers will check it.

limit is rank-CISC (equivalently exponential-Borda, the continuous analogue of

coincide exactly iff c is, within each item, a strictly increasing transform of
the within-item normal score with no ties — i.e. iff the within-item confidence
distribution is Gaussian and untied. In general they differ, and DTV-rank is
the monotone-invariant member of the family. The exact CISC anchor therefore
holds "for the matched score map"; we report both DTV-rank and DTV-value in
every table so the claim is auditable.

========================================================================

     continuous. A composition of continuous maps is continuous, so
     g is CONTINUOUS in Dhat everywhere, and jointly continuous in (Dhat, SE).

 R-SHIFT (dev->test distribution shift; where DTV-dev must win or die):
   estimate on regime A, deploy on regime B for
   (A,B) in {(+0.3,-0.3), (+0.6,0), (0,+0.6), (+0.3, R-ECHO)}.
   DTV-free re-estimates online; DTV-dev and CISC-devT cannot.
 R-REAL (optional but strongly recommended; reviewers will demand it):
   one small instruct model's verbalized confidence + one P(True) channel on a
   GSM8K/MATH subset, 300 items x 16 traces. Expected near-zero discrimination
   with ceiling confidence — the realistic analogue of kappa_c ~ 0, needed to
   pre-empt "kappa_c = -0.6 is a strawman".

========================================================================
B. METHODS UNDER TEST
========================================================================
Ours: DTV-dev; DTV-free-GLS; DTV-free-HW; DTV-free (consensus, DEFAULT);
DTV-free + 25-item sign certificate; DTV-online (prequential).
Ablations (one factor at a time, full grid on R-SWEEP + R-ECHO):
 score map {rank_normal, rank_uniform, value_z, log};
 shrinkage {none, James-Stein, LCB(z=1.645), LCB(z=2.5)};
 sign handling {signed, clamped to gamma>=0};
 pbar correction in Eq.(7) {on, off};
 weight form {multiplicative (1), additive (1')};
 echo layer {on, off}; HW lack-of-fit gate {on, off};
 pi estimator {mixture, monotone fallback, dev-fitted};
 eta {0.5, 1.0}.
Baselines (all at matched token budget):
 1. Plain SC (the G2 floor).
 2. CISC, fixed gamma in {0.25, 0.5, 1, 2, 4} — the F4 grid.
 3. CISC-devT: softmax temperature tuned on a labeled 10% held-out split per
    the ORIGINAL protocol (arXiv:2502.06233). THIS IS THE PUBLISHED
    dev-calibrated SC<->CISC interpolation and the single most dangerous
    baseline; it must appear in the headline table.
 4. Binary ECE gate (prior in-house method; dev ECE > 0.10 disables channel) —
    the F3 reference.
 5. Binary DISCRIMINATION gate: full CISC iff dev WQD > 0.5 + delta, else SC.
    Isolates "right metric" from "continuous tempering". Without this ablation
    nobody can tell which change did the work.
 6. Sign-corrected 3-level gate: gamma in {-1, 0, +1} picked on dev. Tests
    whether EXPLOITING negative correlation needs continuity.
 7. Self-certainty Borda voting, exponent p swept (arXiv:2502.18581) — the
    published rank-based confidence vote; DTV's rank claim must beat fixed-p.
 8. DeepConf-style: keep top-eta% by group confidence + weighted vote, online
    warmup threshold (arXiv:2508.15260).
 9. ReASC-online adapted: confidence-weighted Beta pseudo-counts
    v += max(1, exp(lambda z)) with a 2-component GMM fit to unlabeled
    test-time confidences (arXiv:2601.02970) — closest published label-free
    competitor; expected to collapse for kappa_c < 0.
10. Raykar-style EM: latent item answer (posterior from vote counts) alternating
    with logistic P(correct | s) = sigmoid(a + b s); b is the label-free
    gamma_hat. The fairest representative of the crowdsourcing lineage and the
    strongest label-free competitor.
11. Vanilla Dawid-Skene EM over deduped answer clusters with trace slots as
    annotators — expected to tie SC (degeneracy under exchangeability); include
    to demonstrate the argument empirically, not to beat it.
12. RASC-lite (existing harness baseline; documents the 0.062 collapse).
13. ORACLE-tempered CISC: gamma tuned per-regime with ground truth (upper
    envelope), plus ORACLE per-ITEM gamma on R-HET.
14. Recalibrate-then-weight: logistic recalibration of c on dev with an
    unconstrained (sign-capable) slope, then log-odds weighted vote — the
    classic composition DTV-dev is closest to. Report the difference honestly.

========================================================================
C. METRICS
========================================================================
Primary: accuracy per (method, regime, kappa, budget).
Headline single number: AUCF = mean accuracy over the 7-point kappa sweep at
m = 8 ("area under the confidence-usage frontier").
Safety number: worst-case regret WCR = max over ALL cells of
[acc(SC) - acc(method)]. Report WCR for every method; this is the number that
distinguishes DTV from CISC and DeepConf and it is the paper's core claim.
Estimator diagnostics (not accuracy, but essential):
 - gamma_hat recovery: |gamma_hat - gamma_oracle| and the scatter of gamma_hat
   vs true kappa_c, with the LCB shrinkage visible as a dead zone near 0;
 - SIGN-ERROR RATE of Dhat_free vs xi (the Eq.(19) boundary test);
 - pihat calibration (reliability diagram of pihat vs realized P(plurality
   correct)); effective-N / echo-detector ROC;
 - HW lack-of-fit power against p_echo;
 - the ORACLE-gamma / gamma*(D) ratio, to detect any systematic offset between
   the derived link (7) and the accuracy-optimal exponent (if it is a stable
   constant, absorb it into eta and SAY SO);
 - tie fraction and its effect on rank maps (R-LUMPY).

========================================================================
D. STATISTICS (pre-registered; this is where G2 is made falsifiable)
========================================================================
Pairing: all methods on identical pools; paired comparisons only.
Primary test: exact one-sided McNemar (binomial on discordant pairs) per cell.
Effect sizes and CIs: item-level cluster bootstrap (resample ITEMS, 2000 reps),
averaged over the R = 200 sub-pool draws to remove Monte-Carlo sampling noise
in the budget assignment. Decisions use the fixed canonical assignment
(conservative, valid); effect sizes use the multi-draw mean (higher precision).
Multiplicity: Holm-Bonferroni over the entire declared family, with the family
enumerated in the pre-registration (7 kappa x 4 budgets x 6 regime families =
168 cells for F2). Report the family size in the paper.
Non-inferiority margins (pre-registered, absolute accuracy):
 delta_NI(F2, vs SC)   = 1.0 pp
 delta_NI(F1, vs CISC) = 0.5 pp
 delta_MIN(F3)         = 1.0 pp improvement required
 delta_TIE(F4)         = 0.5 pp
Power: with Q = 400 a 1 pp paired difference gives ~24 expected discordant
pairs and the exact McNemar has low power; therefore the cells that DECIDE F2
(kappa in {-0.1, 0, +0.1}) are pre-registered at Q = 2000 items. If discordant
pairs < 10 in any cell, report "no evidence of difference" with the exact
binomial interval rather than a p-value.
Direct test of Proposition P4: on the kappa = 0 pool, bootstrap the dev split
200 times and verify empirically that P(gamma_hat != 0) <= alpha_s = 0.05.
This is a check of the mechanism, independent of accuracy.

========================================================================
E. THE FOUR PRE-REGISTERED FALSIFIERS, SHARPENED
========================================================================
F1 (G1: match CISC where confidence is discriminative). FAILS if DTV-dev's
accuracy is below CISC-devT by more than 0.5 pp with a Holm-corrected one-sided
McNemar p < 0.05 at kappa_c = +0.6 or +0.3. CEILING GUARD: at kappa = +0.6
CISC is at 1.000 and the test is vacuous; the pre-registered decision budget is
m = 8, chosen so CISC accuracy falls in [0.80, 0.98], and the real G1 tests are
kappa = +0.3 and the R-MONO distortions where discrimination is preserved but
values are mangled.

F2 (G2: never significantly below SC). FAILS if, in ANY of the 168 declared
cells, the upper end of the paired difference [acc(DTV) - acc(SC)] lies below
-1.0 pp at Holm-corrected alpha = 0.05. Report the maximum observed deficit and
its cell. Applies to BOTH DTV-dev and DTV-free. The R-ECHO cells are declared
in advance as a SEPARATE, conditional family: G2 is claimed unconditionally on
R-SWEEP / R-HET / R-MONO / R-TAIL / R-LUMPY, and CONDITIONALLY on R-ECHO given
the echo detector or the 25-item sign certificate. Failing G2 on R-ECHO WITHOUT
the certificate is a predicted, published limitation, not a surprise; failing it
WITH the certificate falsifies the mitigation.

F3 (the label-free estimator must earn its complexity). FAILS if DTV-free's
AUCF does not exceed the binary ECE gate's AUCF by >= 1.0 pp with a 95% cluster
bootstrap CI excluding 0. STRONGER, ALSO PRE-REGISTERED: DTV-free must also
beat the binary DISCRIMINATION (WQD/AUC) gate. If it beats the ECE gate but not
the WQD gate, the paper must report that the metric change (ECE -> WQD), not the
online estimation, did the work — and the label-free contribution shrinks to the
echo analysis. Secondary F3 comparators: ReASC-online and Raykar-EM.

F4 (does continuous tempering add anything?). Declared a NEGATIVE RESULT and
published as such if the best of {dev-picked fixed gamma from {0,0.25,0.5,1,2},
CISC-devT, binary WQD gate, sign-corrected 3-level gate, recalibrate-then-weight}
is within 0.5 pp of DTV on EVERY cell. Pre-registered expectation: the
sign-corrected 3-level gate will be close on the pure kappa sweep (weighted-vote
accuracy is famously flat in gamma), and DTV must separate on R-HET, R-MONO,
R-TAIL and above all R-SHIFT, where a frozen dev-tuned exponent is stale and
DTV-online re-estimates. If DTV wins ONLY on R-SHIFT and the label-free setting,
say exactly that in the abstract.

F. REPORTING DISCIPLINE
========================================================================

hyperparameters.name: score_map
hyperparameters.meaning: Within-item transform of confidence. rank_normal = Blom/van der Waerden normal score of the midrank, standardized to mean 0 / variance 1 within item; monotone-invariant, so any per-item or global miscalibration of c is annihilated. rank_uniform is the Wilcoxon variant. value_z and log exist only to realize the exact CISC-softmax and CISC-power anchors and are run as ablations.

hyperparameters.name: z_shrink (alpha_s)
hyperparameters.meaning: One-sided z-quantile used for the LCB soft-threshold in Eq.(11). Directly sets the SC-safety level: under a null channel P(gamma_hat != 0) <= alpha_s and E[acc(DTV)] >= E[acc(SC)] - alpha_s. Raise to 2.5 for a paranoid deployment (alpha ~ 0.006) at the cost of under-using weak-but-real signal. Doubled automatically when the Hui-Walter lack-of-fit test fires.

hyperparameters.name: Gamma (gamma_max)
hyperparameters.meaning: Cap on |gamma_hat|. Also DEFINES the full-trust CISC anchor: with the log score map, DTV at gamma = Gamma is literally CISC with exponent Gamma. At m = 40, max|s| ~ 2.1, so Gamma = 3 gives a top/bottom weight ratio of ~e^{12.6} ~ 3e5, i.e. effectively argmax-confidence — beyond this the predictions no longer change, so a larger cap buys nothing and only amplifies estimation error.

hyperparameters.name: eta (fractional trust)
hyperparameters.meaning: Kelly-style multiplier on the derived exponent. eta = 1 is 'full Kelly on the already-shrunk estimate' and is the default because the LCB does the safety work. eta = 0.5 (half-Kelly) is the recommended setting when the dev pair count is below 2000 or when a stable oracle/derived gamma offset is detected in the diagnostics; eta is the designated absorber for any systematic mismatch between the link (7) and the accuracy-optimal exponent.

hyperparameters.name: pbar_correction
hyperparameters.meaning: Whether to apply the sqrt(1 + pbar(1-pbar)u^2) factor in Eq.(7), which converts a unit-TOTAL-variance standardized score into the unit-WITHIN-COMPONENT-variance scale the log-odds slope is defined on. Correction is <= 12% for |D| <= 0.52 and can be disabled (equivalently pbar set to 0 or 1) with the residual absorbed into eta.

hyperparameters.name: weight_form
hyperparameters.meaning: multiplicative w = exp(gamma s) (Eq. 1) is the default: nonnegative by construction and the form that gives the exact CISC reduction. additive w = max(0, 1 + gamma s) (Eq. 1') is the exact naive-Bayes / Nitzan-Paroush log-odds pool and is Bayes-optimal under model M0; the two agree to O(gamma^2) and both equal SC at gamma = 0.

hyperparameters.name: Dmax
hyperparameters.meaning: Clip on the shrunk discrimination before the probit link, preventing Phi^{-1} from diverging. Only ever active in near-perfect-channel regimes where the Gamma cap already binds.

hyperparameters.name: min_dev_pairs / min_dev_items
hyperparameters.meaning: Refuse to estimate (return gamma_hat = 0 = SC) unless the dev split provides at least this many within-item discordant pairs and this many items with both a correct and an incorrect trace. Prevents a wild exponent from a handful of pairs.

hyperparameters.name: tie_handling
hyperparameters.meaning: Midranks for tied confidences; items with zero within-item score variance (all confidences identical, common under the simulator's 0.01/0.99 clipping and under real ceiling-confidence channels) contribute w = 1 to every trace, i.e. those items fall back to SC automatically. Wilcoxon tie correction T_q is applied to the null variance in Eq.(9).

hyperparameters.name: W0 / W / U (online schedule)
hyperparameters.meaning: Warm-up items during which gamma = 0 (pure SC); sliding estimation-window length in items; refresh interval in items. The gamma applied to an item is always estimated from strictly earlier items, and the agreement pseudo-label is always the PLAIN-SC plurality, never DTV's own output, to prevent self-confirmation.

hyperparameters.name: pi_estimator
hyperparameters.meaning: How P(plurality correct | margin) is obtained for the GLS de-attenuation: a 2-component beta-binomial mixture on the duplication-deflated top-share (k_eff, n_eff) with an ordering constraint, guarded by a BIC margin of 2; if BIC prefers one component the estimator falls back to a conservative monotone rule that DROPS all items with top-share < 0.5. A third option fits the margin->pi map on the 25-item sign-certificate labels.
hyperparameters.default: mixture with BIC guard, monotone fallback

hyperparameters.name: B (Hui-Walter margin bins)
hyperparameters.meaning: Number of vote-margin strata in the two-view latent-class estimator. Identification requires B >= 2 (3B observed cells vs 4 + B unknowns); B = 4 gives 4 degrees of freedom for the conditional-independence lack-of-fit chi-square, which is the echo/dependence diagnostic.

hyperparameters.name: lof_alpha
hyperparameters.meaning: Significance level of the Hui-Walter lack-of-fit chi-square (df = 2B - 4). Below it, conditional independence given correctness is rejected — the statistical signature of echo/correlated errors — and the HW estimate is discarded while the GLS shrinkage is doubled.

hyperparameters.name: rho_dup / tau_s (per-item echo flag)
hyperparameters.meaning: An item is flagged as echo if its Kish effective trace count n_eff/m falls below rho_dup (duplication-driven plurality, computed from the TracePool similarity matrix) AND the plurality cluster's mean score exceeds tau_s standard deviations (the plurality is also the high-confidence cluster). Flagged items are excluded from ESTIMATION only; their votes are untouched.

hyperparameters.name: tau_echo
hyperparameters.meaning: Global abstain threshold: if more than this fraction of items are echo-flagged, gamma_hat is forced to 0 (hard SC fallback) and ECHO_ABSTAIN is emitted. This is the operational reason G2 is claimed only conditionally in echo regimes.

hyperparameters.name: K (sign certificate size)
hyperparameters.meaning: Number of labeled items used solely to certify the SIGN of the channel's discrimination — the one bit that is information-theoretically unidentifiable label-free. Power analysis from the null variance gives K >= 3 for |D| = 0.3 at 80% power with m = 40; K = 25 is the pre-registered default (8x margin for clustering, heterogeneity and small m). A sign conflict with the label-free estimate forces gamma_hat = 0.

known_failure_modes: SIGN NON-IDENTIFIABILITY (fundamental, not an engineering gap). With one exchangeable confidence channel and no labels, 'confidence discriminates positively but the plurality is wrong on a fraction of items' and 'confidence anti-discriminates but the plurality is right' induce identical observable laws, because 'correct' is merely an unobserved labeling of one answer cluster per item. Every label-free estimator must impose an identifying restriction; ours is pibar > 1/2 (equivalently alpha1 > alpha0 in the Hui-Walter fit), which echo regimes violate by construction. Consequence: G2 for DTV-free is CONDITIONAL. Mitigations shipped: the two-estimator sign-consensus (returns exactly 0 on disagreement), the echo detector, and the 25-item sign certificate. The only assumption-free escape is an extra elicitation channel (Prelec surprisingly-popular meta-predictions).

THE INFORMATION/TRUST TENSION IN THE AGREEMENT PROXY. Estimation information per item is n_q^ag = k_q(m_q - k_q), maximized at a 50/50 vote split — exactly the items where P(plurality correct) is lowest. Unanimous items are trustworthy but carry zero information. The GLS de-attenuation (Eq. 17) is the optimal compromise under the working model, but it cannot manufacture information: in a corpus where all informative items are contested, DTV-free's estimate is intrinsically noisy and the LCB will correctly collapse it toward SC. Expect DTV-free to under-use a genuinely good channel on hard corpora — a conservative, not a dangerous, failure.

ECHO POISONING ABOVE THE EQ.(19) THRESHOLD. When the echo cluster's confidence advantage xibar exceeds |D|(2 pibar - 1)/(1 - pibar), the label-free sign estimate flips and DTV actively amplifies the wrong answer — strictly worse than SC. At pibar = 0.6 the tolerance is only xibar < 0.5|D|. The detector (duplication-deflated n_eff plus the Hui-Walter lack-of-fit chi-square) reduces but does not eliminate this; a smooth, low-duplication, well-spread echo with a modest confidence boost is designed to evade it. Present R-ECHO as a documented limitation with the predicted boundary overlaid on the measured sign-error surface.

HETEROGENEOUS PER-ITEM RELIABILITY BREAKS THE SCALAR ESTIMAND. A single global gamma is misspecified when kappa varies across items; moreover the pooled estimator (8) targets the PAIR-WEIGHTED mean of D_q, which differs from the plain mean when reliability correlates with difficulty. A per-item gamma is data-starved at m = 40 (and hopeless at m = 4) and the agreement proxy cannot support it without heavy shrinkage. Scope the claim explicitly to global, channel-level tempering and report the oracle per-item envelope as the gap you are not closing.

LINEAR-IN-SCORE MISSPECIFICATION (regime iv). exp(gamma s) can only express a monotone log-linear trust profile. If confidence is informative only in the tails, the single-slope fit under-uses it and DTV lands near SC while an oracle tail rule wins. The DTV-np isotonic/spline extension addresses this on dev; the label-free version of it is only coarsely available (3-bin de-attenuation) and is scoped as future work.

MIXTURE NON-IDENTIFIABILITY NEAR ZERO RELIABILITY. The beta-binomial margin mixture used for pihat is weakly identified when the top-share distribution is unimodal — which is exactly the near-kappa-zero regime where the estimator must confidently return gamma = 0. The BIC guard plus the monotone fallback plus the LCB make the failure benign (it degrades to SC) but it means pihat, and hence the de-attenuation scale, is unreliable at low signal; do not report pihat-derived quantities in that regime.

TIE-HEAVY AND CEILING-BOUND CONFIDENCE. Real verbalized confidences pile up on 0.8/0.9/0.95, and the simulator's own clip at 0.01/0.99 creates the same pathology at |kappa_c| = 0.6. Midranks handle ties correctly but destroy resolution: at m = 4 with three-way ties the within-item score is nearly constant and DTV degenerates to SC. Report the tie fraction per pool; R-LUMPY is the designated stress test.

SELF-CONFIRMATION IF THE PSEUDO-LABEL IS COMPUTED AGAINST DTV'S OWN OUTPUT. Using the weighted plurality rather than the plain-SC plurality creates a positive feedback loop: a spuriously positive gamma makes high-confidence answers win more, which makes agreement correlate more with confidence, which raises gamma. The online schedule forbids this. It is a silent, catastrophic bug if reintroduced — assert it in the code.

ANSWER-CLUSTERING ERRORS CORRELATE WITH ECHO. The pseudo-label depends on the TracePool's semantic-equivalence clustering; over-merging inflates the plurality (raising pihat spuriously) and under-merging fragments it. Because near-duplicate traces are both the most likely to be merged and the most likely to form an echo, clustering error is correlated with exactly the failure mode we are trying to detect. Report sensitivity to the clustering threshold.

F4 MAY SIMPLY FIRE. Weighted-vote accuracy is empirically flat in gamma over wide ranges, so a sign-corrected 3-level gate (gamma in {-1, 0, +1} picked on dev) or CISC's own dev-tuned temperature may match DTV's whole frontier on the pure kappa sweep. This is a genuinely likely outcome and is pre-registered as a publishable negative result; the remaining defensible territory is then label-free operation, distribution shift (R-SHIFT), and the echo analysis.

DTV-DEV IS LARGELY A REPACKAGING. On iid dev/test splits DTV-dev is shrunk logistic recalibration plus Nitzan-Paroush log-odds pooling, and CISC-devT is the published dev-calibrated SC<->CISC interpolation. Expect a tie. Do not stake the paper on DTV-dev.

PROPOSITION P4 IS A NULL-ONLY GUARANTEE. E[acc(DTV)] >= E[acc(SC)] - alpha_s holds when D = 0. Off the null, a correctly signed but overestimated gamma can still lose to SC on particular items (overbetting a real but small edge), and no distribution-free bound is available. The Kelly and James-Stein framings are motivation, not theorems, for the voting objective; do not state G2 as a theorem.

MULTIPLE-COMPARISON FRAGILITY OF G2. 'Never significantly below SC anywhere' over 168 cells is a multiplicity lottery unless the family is enumerated in advance with Holm correction and pre-registered non-inferiority margins, and unless the deciding near-zero-kappa cells are run at Q = 2000 (at Q = 400 a 1 pp effect yields ~24 discordant pairs and the exact McNemar is underpowered).

SIM-TO-REAL. The linear-Gaussian confidence model makes the rank and value maps nearly equivalent by construction, and makes the probit link (7) close to exact; both advantages evaporate on real channels. Without R-MONO, R-LUMPY and ideally R-REAL, the rank claim and the derived link are untested rather than validated.
